s: Implementing a base class for plugin development in Python enhances adaptability and viability. Object-oriented programming, particularly with Python's OOP syntax, is leveraged to create reusable and extensible application components, simplifying long-term maintenance.
sub: Leveraging AI coding assistants for OOP confidence
BaseApp class for plugin system with CRUD operations
Wrapper classes (e.g., TodoApp, ProfileApp) extending BaseApp
Benefits of OOP for adaptability and code reusability in plugins
